findings.what: Circuit follows IR2110 reference design verbatim with documented deviations
Bootstrap capacitor sized correctly for 100-500kHz operation: 0.47µF provides 47% margin over calculated 320nF minimum
Gate resistors (5.1Ω) provide peak current 2.35A, within IR2110 2.5A max rating
Source-to-gate resistors (10kΩ) present on both FETs per IR2110 critical requirement
All power supply pins properly decoupled: VCC (0.1µF + 10µF), VDD (0.1µF)
Snubbers marked DNF (do not fit) - appropriate for initial build, populate if ringing observed
GaN FET not available from JLCPCB - using Si MOSFET IPP80N05S4-02. Documented deviation, efficiency impact 1-2%.
IR2110 driver part LCSC number TBD - needs sourcing from JLCPCB catalog. Placeholder symbol/footprint used.
Bootstrap diode (D_BOOT) using placeholder 1N5819 - needs JLCPCB sourcing for actual Schottky part
Dead-time requirement: 200-300ns minimum between HI_IN and LO_IN to prevent shoot-through. Provided by external DEAD_TIME_GENERATOR block.
Bootstrap recharge constraint: requires minimum ~10% duty cycle for low-side FET. LLC control loop must enforce this.

notes: Circuit topology matches IR2110 typical application circuit (AN-978)
All component values justified in values.json with provenance
Critical layout requirements documented in rationale.md
Parts sourced from JLCPCB catalog where available (parts.json)
Interface properly defined: 5 ports, consumes V_BUS_48V + GND rails
No shoot-through risk if dead-time provided by upstream logic
Gate drive current within driver capability
MOSFET ratings adequate: 150V > 48V (3× margin), 80A > 10A RMS (8× margin)

connections_verified.gate_driver_power: VCC_12V to pin 3, VDD_5V to pin 9, both bypassed
connections_verified.gate_driver_inputs: HI_IN to pin 10, LO_IN to pin 12
connections_verified.gate_driver_outputs: HO (pin 7) through 5.1Ω to Q1 gate, LO (pin 1) through 5.1Ω to Q2 gate
connections_verified.bootstrap_circuit: VCC_12V → D_BOOT → VB (pin 6), C_BOOT between VB and VS
connections_verified.power_stage: Q1 drain to V_BUS_48V, Q1 source to switching node (VS), Q2 drain to switching node, Q2 source to GND
connections_verified.pull_downs: 10kΩ Q1 gate to source (VS), 10kΩ Q2 gate to source (GND)
